svg.title: For connector values Yp with nonnegative weights summing to one, take q = xy−1 and τ = P p weightp chord(x−1Ypy). Cyclic invariance identifies it with the discrepancy from q. For m = P p weightp mat(Yp), one has ∥m−mat(q)∥≤colorScale τ. In the best branch its output b is nearest to m, so ∥mat(b) −mat(q)∥≤∥mat(b) −m∥+ ∥m −mat(q)∥≤2 colorScale τ.
